public.title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
public.description: Return the length of the longest run of consecutive distinct integer values, regardless of input order. Duplicates do not extend a run. Empty input returns 0. There are 0 to 1000 integers between -1000000 and 1000000.
hints: Only start counting from values whose predecessor is absent.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Each run is scanned once from its minimum value, avoiding repeated work. Set operations give expected O(n) time.
